title: The Work That Can Wait
lessons: productivity is not the same as worth
a boundary is a form of control

text: The office has thinned to vents and monitor glow.
One unfinished task keeps its cursor blinking like a small accusation.
You could make the evening productive. You could also end it.

choices.text: Do twenty focused minutes, then close the file.
Write tomorrow's first step and leave now.

text: The file is smaller. You are not.
Tomorrow has instructions waiting for it.
